## Compatibility checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes against a local Redis
- [ ] Behavioral changes cite the gocraft/work v0.5.1 source they match (file and function)
- [ ] Files under `src/pygowork/lua/` are untouched, or are verbatim carries from upstream with the attribution header kept
- [ ] Any divergence from upstream is documented in the module docstring and the README
- [ ] The README's carried-surface list still tells the truth
